observations.why: Imperative directive performing a settled, load-bearing instruction the speaker expects compliance with — 'Forget everything' is operational ratification language, not an argued position. No hedges, no epistemic softening; the act itself performs the settling.

Same operational register as src-1: a flat imperative with universal quantifier 'all' and no hedging — the speaker performs a settled instruction expected to be acted on, not a position under argument.
